# Support

Thanks for using Templatical. Here is where each kind of question goes.

## Bugs

[File an issue](https://github.com/templatical/sdk/issues) with a minimal reproduction — the template JSON, the `init()` config, and what you expected instead. A runnable repro on [the playground](https://play.templatical.com) is the fastest route to a fix.

## Questions and ideas

[Open a discussion](https://github.com/templatical/sdk/discussions). Prefer this over email for anything that is not private: the answer stays searchable for whoever hits the same thing next.

Read [the documentation](https://docs.templatical.com) first — the [Quick Start](https://docs.templatical.com/getting-started/quick-start) covers embedding, and the [guide](https://docs.templatical.com/guide/blocks) covers the block model.

## Security

Do not open a public issue. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for the private channels.

## Licensing and commercial use

Email `hi@templatical.com`. The [License FAQ](https://docs.templatical.com/license-faq) answers most FSL questions; write if yours is not covered or you would rather not ask in public.

## Code of conduct

Reports go to `hi@templatical.com` — see [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
